summary: A composite-fuselage super mid-size business jet distinguished by its high T-tail, swept wings, and stand-up cabin class. Shown here in three static exterior configurations built from photographic reference.
overview: The Hawker 4000 sits in the super mid-size business jet category, frequently considered for regional and longer multi-hour legs carrying a small executive group or family party with stand-up cabin comfort.

This interactive exterior model was constructed from public photographic references in a pearl-white, Atlantic blue, and champagne livery. Switch between In Flight, Parked, and Boarding states to examine the high T-tail, rear nacelles, tricycle undercarriage, and forward airstair geometry. The Boarding configuration depicts a shallow display vestibule and is not a full cabin interior.
tripConsiderations: Often reviewed for regional business corridors and family itineraries needing super mid-size cabin volume.
Not presented as a 22-passenger group aircraft; larger groups require a dedicated group charter evaluation.
Exact seating layout, baggage hold volume, range under actual payload, and runway suitability are verified per tail by the operating carrier.

summary: The original Dassault Falcon 2000 Classic configuration, recognized by its wide fuselage cross-section, nine cabin windows per side, clean wing tips without winglets, and mid-fin horizontal tail.
overview: The original Falcon 2000 Classic introduced a noticeably wide cabin footprint within a twin-engine layout, valued by travellers prioritizing shoulder room and quiet comfort across regional and continental sectors.

This exterior model strictly depicts the Falcon 2000 Classic with original CFE738-style rear nacelles and clean wing tips. It is not a winglet-equipped EX, LX, or LXS variant. Inspect both In Flight and Parked configurations to review the fuselage proportions and empennage geometry.
tripConsiderations: Frequently considered for executive and family regional journeys where wide-cabin comfort is a priority.
Not presented as a 22-passenger group aircraft; group charters are quoted separately on larger airframes.
Actual range, payload limits, cabin seating configuration, and availability are confirmed for each route by the aviation team.
